description.zh: 弹性网卡当前附加的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance to which the ENI is attached.

description.zh: 弹性网卡的IPv6地址。N表示可以设置多个IPv6地址，N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: An array that consists of the IPv6 address of the ENI. You can specify multiple IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：

- 当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。
- 当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default values:

- If this parameter is not specified or if this parameter is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.

- If this parameter is set to a value greater than 500, the default value is 500.

description.zh: 弹性网卡ID。N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: An array that consists of the IDs of the ENIs. You specify multiple ENI IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 弹性网卡的名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the ENI.

description.zh:
查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的`NextToken`参数值。

有关本接口查看返回数据的设置方式，请参见上文接口说明。
description.en:
The query token. Set the value to the `NextToken` value returned in the last call to this operation.

For more information about how to check the responses returned by this operation, see the preceding "Description" section.

description.zh: > 该参数已废弃，建议您通过指定MaxResults或NextToken参数时使用分页方式查询。
description.en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

> This parameter will be removed in the future. We recommend that you use NextToken and MaxResults for a paged query.

description.zh: > 该参数已废弃，建议您通过指定MaxResults或NextToken参数时使用分页方式查询。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 10.

> This parameter will be removed in the future. We recommend that you use NextToken and MaxResults for a paged query.

description.zh: 弹性网卡主私网IPv4地址。
description.en: The primary private IPv4 address of the ENI.

description.zh: 弹性网卡的辅助私网IPv4地址。N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: An array that consists of the secondary private IPv4 addresses of the ENI. You can specify multiple secondary private IPv4 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 所在地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the ENI. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

>不支持默认资源组过滤。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the ENI belongs. If this parameter is specified to query resources, up to 1,000 resources that belong to the specified resource group can be returned.

> Resources in the default resource group are displayed in the response regardless of how this parameter is set.

description.zh:
辅助网卡对应的安全组ID。

- 如果您需要通过安全组ID查询辅助网卡的信息，请指定该参数。
- 如果您需要通过安全组ID查询主网卡信息，请调用[DescribeInstances](~~25506~~)指定`SecurityGroupId`参数进行查询。
description.en:
The ID of the security group to which the secondary ENI belongs.

- To query the details of secondary ENIs based on the ID of a security group, specify this parameter.

- To query the details of primary ENIs based on the ID of a security group, call the [DescribeInstances](~~25506~~) operation and specify the `SecurityGroupId` parameter.

description.zh: 该弹性网卡的使用者是否为云产品或虚商。
description.en: Specifies whether the user of the ENI is an Alibaba Cloud service or a distributor.

description.zh:
弹性网卡的状态。取值范围：

* Available：可用。
* Attaching：附加中。
* InUse：已附加。
* Detaching：分离中。
* Deleting：删除中。

默认值：空，表示查询所有状态。
description.en:
The state of the ENI. Valid values:

- Available: The ENI is available.

- Attaching: The ENI is being attached to an instance.

- InUse: The ENI is attached to an instance.

- Detaching: The ENI is being detached from an instance.

- Deleting: The ENI is being deleted.

This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that ENIs in all states are queried.

description.zh: 标签列表
description.en: The tags to use for query.

description.zh: 弹性网卡的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20
description.en: The key of tag N of the ENI. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh:
弹性网卡的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用[ListTagResources](~~110425~~)接口进行查询。
description.en:
The value of tag N of the ENI. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If a single tag is specified to query ENIs, up to 1,000 ENIs that have this tag can be returned. If multiple tags are specified to query ENIs, up to 1,000 ENIs that have all these tags can be returned. To query more than 1,000 resources that have specified tags, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation.

description.zh:
弹性网卡类型。取值范围：

- Primary：主网卡。
- Secondary：辅助网卡。

默认值：空，表示查询所有类型。
description.en:
The type of the ENI. Valid values:

- Primary

- Secondary

This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that both primary and secondary ENIs are queried.

description.zh: 弹性网卡所属的交换机ID。
description.en: The ID of the vSwitch with which the ENI is associated.

description.zh: 弹性网卡所属的专有网络VPC ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the elastic network interface (ENI) belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

`DescribeNetworkInterfaces`接口支持指定`MaxResults`或`NextToken`参数通过分页查询。具体使用说明：

- 分页查询首页时，仅需设置`MaxResults`以限制返回信息的条目数，返回结果中的`NextToken`将作为查询后续页的凭证。

- 查询后续页时，将`NextToken`参数设置为上一次返回结果中获取到的`NextToken`作为查询凭证，并设置`MaxResults`限制返回条目数。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

You can call the `DescribeNetworkInterfaces` operation for paged query by specifying the `MaxResults` or `NextToken` parameter. Take note of the following items:

- During a paged query, when you call the DescribeNetworkInterfaces operation to retrieve the first page of results, set `MaxResults` to specify the maximum number of entries to return in the call. The return value of `NextToken` is a pagination token that can be used in the next call to retrieve a new page of results.

- When you call the DescribeNetworkInterfaces operation to retrieve a new page of results, set `NextToken` to the `NextToken` value returned in the previous call and set `MaxResults` to specify the maximum number of entries to return in this call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-network-interfaces --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp16usj2p27htro30000 --vpc-id vpc-bp1j7w3gc1cexjqd0000 --primary-ip-address 192.168.00.00 --security-group-id sg-bp144yr32sx6ndw0000 --network-interface-name test-eni-name --type Secondary --instance-id i-bp1e2l6djkndyuli0000 --service-managed true --status Available --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 50 --private-ip-address 192.168.00.00 --network-interface-id eni-bp125p95hhdhn3ot0000 --ipv6-address 2408:4321:180:1701:94c7:bc38:3bfa:0000 --region cn-hangzhou
